recommended_treatment_en: Remove and burn infected leaves or plants
recommended_treatment_ha: Cire kuma ƙone ganyen da cuta ta kama
Yi amfani da maganin fungal da ke ɗauke da jan karfe (misali Copper Oxychloride)
Guji zuba ruwa a saman ganye
application_steps_en: Mix 20g Copper Oxychloride in 15L of water
Wear gloves and mask before mixing
Spray all infected leaves thoroughly early morning
Repeat after 5 days if spots persist
application_steps_ha: Haɗa Copper Oxychloride gram 20 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Sa safar hannu da rufe hanci kafin haɗawa
Yi feshi sosai a kan ganyen da cuta ta kama da safe
Maimaita bayan kwana 5 idan tabon ba su ƙare ba
high.dosage_en: 20g per 15L water. Apply to all infected areas. Repeat weekly if needed.
high.dosage_ha: Gram 20 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi amfani a duk wuraren da cuta ta kama. Maimaita kowane mako idan ya cancanta.
high.timing_en: Spray early morning (before 9AM) or late evening. Avoid spraying in hot sun.
high.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe kafin karfe 9 ko da maraice. Kada ka yi feshi lokacin zafin rana.
safety_warnings_en: Keep children and livestock away during spraying
safety_warnings_ha: Sanya kayan kariya (safar hannu, rufe hanci)
Guji yara da dabbobi a lokacin feshi
Wanke hannaye bayan amfani da magunguna
high.expected_outcome_en: Leaf spots should dry and stop spreading within 5-7 days. New growth will be healthy.
high.expected_outcome_ha: Tabon ganye ya kamata su bushe su daina yaɗuwa cikin kwana 5-7. Sabbin ganye zasu zama lafiya.
high.input_sourcing_en: Available at agro-dealer shops. Copper Oxychloride is common. Organic option: Bordeaux mixture.
high.input_sourcing_ha: Ana samunsa a kantunan taki da magani. Copper Oxychloride ya zama ruwan dare. Madadin gargajiya: ruwan Bordeaux.
future_prevention_en: Rotate with non-host crops (maize or sorghum)
future_prevention_ha: Yi juyin amfanin gona da masara ko dawa
Yi amfani da iri masu kyau ba tare da cuta ba

recommended_treatment_ha: Cire ganyen da ke ɗauke da cuta
Yi feshi da maganin Mancozeb
application_steps_en: Pick off all spotted leaves and burn them
Spray only the remaining healthy leaves
Repeat after 7 days if new spots appear
application_steps_ha: Cire duk ganyen da ke da tabo ka ƙone su
Haɗa Mancozeb gram 15 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Yi feshi kawai a kan ganyen da suka rage lafiya
Maimaita bayan kwana 7 idan sababbin tabo suka bayyana
moderate.dosage_en: 15g per 15L water. Apply only to affected areas.
moderate.dosage_ha: Gram 15 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi amfani kawai a wuraren da cuta ta kama.
moderate.timing_en: Spray in the morning or evening. Avoid windy days.
moderate.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe ko da yamma. Kada ka yi feshi lokacin iska.
safety_warnings_en: Do not eat or drink while spraying
safety_warnings_ha: Sanya safar hannu da rufe hanci
Kada ka ci ko sha yayin feshi
Ajiye magunguna nesa da abinci
moderate.expected_outcome_en: Remaining leaves should stay healthy. Disease spread should stop within 3-5 days.
moderate.expected_outcome_ha: Ganyen da suka rage su kasance lafiya. Yaɗuwar cuta ya kamata ta tsaya cikin kwana 3-5.
moderate.input_sourcing_en: Mancozeb is widely available at agro-dealers. Also sold as Dithane M-45.
moderate.input_sourcing_ha: Ana samun Mancozeb sosai a kantunan taki. Ana sayar da shi da sunan Dithane M-45.
future_prevention_ha: Guji shuka wake da yawa a wuri ɗaya
Kula da tsaftar gona

recommended_treatment_en: Spray neem extract as organic control
recommended_treatment_ha: Yi amfani da ruwan ganyen neem a matsayin magani
Kula akai-akai kowane mako
application_steps_en: Soak 1kg neem leaves in 10L water overnight
Strain and spray on all leaves
application_steps_ha: Jika ganyen neem kilogiram 1 a cikin ruwa lita 10 dare ɗaya
Tace ka yi feshi a kan ganye duka
Maimaita kowane mako na makonni 3
low.dosage_en: 1kg neem leaves per 10L water. Apply liberally.
low.dosage_ha: Ganyen neem kilogiram 1 a cikin ruwa lita 10. Yi amfani da yawa.
low.timing_en: Spray early morning or late afternoon.
low.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe ko da yamma.
safety_warnings_en: Neem extract is safe, but avoid contact with eyes.
safety_warnings_ha: Ruwan neem ba shi da laifi, amma ka guji shiga ido.
Wanke hannaye bayan feshi.
low.expected_outcome_en: Minor spots should fade. Vigilance needed to catch reoccurrence.
low.expected_outcome_ha: Ƙananan tabo za su shuɗe. Ana buƙatar kulawa don gano sake faruwa.
low.input_sourcing_en: Neem trees are common; you can prepare extract yourself. Also sold as Neem oil in shops.
low.input_sourcing_ha: Itacen neem yana da yawa; za ka iya shirya ruwan da kanka. Ana sayar da mai neem a shaguna.
future_prevention_ha: Kula da tsaftar gona
Yi amfani da iri masu tsafta

recommended_treatment_ha: Yi feshi da maganin fungi kamar Mancozeb ko Chlorothalonil
Cire ganyaye masu cuta ka ƙone su
application_steps_en: Spray all leaves thoroughly, especially underside
Repeat after 7 days if rust persists
application_steps_ha: Haɗa Chlorothalonil mililita 25 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Sanya dukkan kayan kariya
Yi feshi sosai a kan ganye, musamman a ƙarƙashinsu
Maimaita bayan kwana 7 idan tsatsar ba ta ƙare ba
high.dosage_en: 25ml per 15L water. Apply to all foliage.
high.dosage_ha: Mililita 25 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi amfani a dukkan ganye.
high.timing_en: Spray in cool weather, early morning or evening. Avoid spraying before rain.
high.timing_ha: Yi feshi a lokacin sanyi, da safe ko da yamma. Kada ka yi feshi kafin ruwan sama.
safety_warnings_en: Wear mask, gloves, and long sleeves
Keep children and pets away for 24 hours
Do not spray near water sources
safety_warnings_ha: Sanya rufe hanci, safar hannu, da tufafi masu rufe jiki
Guji yara da dabbobi na tsawon sa'o'i 24
Kada ka yi feshi kusa da ruwa
high.expected_outcome_en: Rust pustules should dry up within 5 days. New leaves will be healthy.
high.expected_outcome_ha: Kurajen tsatsa za su bushe cikin kwana 5. Sabbin ganye zasu zama lafiya.
high.input_sourcing_en: Chlorothalonil (e.g., Bravo) and Mancozeb are common at agro-dealers.
high.input_sourcing_ha: Chlorothalonil (misali Bravo) da Mancozeb ana samun su a kantunan taki.
future_prevention_en: Avoid planting in same spot every season
future_prevention_ha: Yi amfani da irin wake da ke da ƙarfi kan tsatsa
Guji shuka a wuri ɗaya duk shekara

recommended_treatment_ha: Haɗa taki na gargajiya don ƙara ƙarfi
Yi feshi da maganin jan karfe idan yana yaduwa
application_steps_en: Apply 5kg compost per 10 square meters around plants
If rust spreads, mix 20g Copper Oxychloride in 15L water
Repeat once if needed after 7 days
application_steps_ha: Zuba taki kilogiram 5 a kowace murabba'i mita 10 kusa da shuke-shuke
Idan tsatsa ta yaɗu, haɗa Copper Oxychloride gram 20 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Yi feshi kawai a kan shuke-shuke masu cuta
Maimaita sau ɗaya idan ya cancanta bayan kwana 7
moderate.dosage_en: 20g per 15L water for spraying. Compost: 5kg per 10m².
moderate.dosage_ha: Gram 20 a cikin ruwa lita 15 don feshi. Taki: kilogiram 5 a kowace mita 10.
moderate.timing_en: Apply compost when soil is moist. Spray early morning or evening.
moderate.timing_ha: Zuba taki lokacin ƙasa tana da ɗanshi. Yi feshi da safe ko da yamma.
safety_warnings_ha: Sa safar hannu lokacin zuba taki
Guji shaka hayakin feshi
moderate.expected_outcome_en: Plants should gain vigor and resist rust. Spots should not increase.
moderate.expected_outcome_ha: Shuke-shuke zasu sami ƙarfi su jure tsatsa. Tabo baza su ƙaru ba.
moderate.input_sourcing_en: Compost from manure or crop residues. Copper fungicides at agro-dealers.
moderate.input_sourcing_ha: Taki daga taki ko ragowar amfanin gona. Magungunan jan karfe a kantunan taki.
future_prevention_ha: Tabbatar tazara don iska
Duba gona akai-akai

recommended_treatment_ha: Yi feshi da mai neem sau ɗaya a mako
Cire ƙananan tabo na tsatsa
application_steps_en: Mix 10ml neem oil in 1L water with a few drops of soap
Spray on both sides of leaves
application_steps_ha: Haɗa mai neem mililita 10 a cikin ruwa lita 1 tare da digo kaɗan na sabulu
Yi feshi a saman da ƙarƙashin ganye
Maimaita kowane mako tsawon wata guda
low.dosage_en: 10ml neem oil per 1L water. Apply to all leaves.
low.dosage_ha: Mililita 10 na mai neem a cikin ruwa lita 1. Yi amfani a kan dukkan ganye.
low.timing_en: Spray in late afternoon to avoid burning leaves.
low.timing_ha: Yi feshi da yamma don guji ƙone ganye.
safety_warnings_en: Neem oil is safe, but avoid contact with eyes.
safety_warnings_ha: Mai neem ba shi da laifi, amma ka guji shiga ido.
Wanke hannaye bayan amfani.
low.expected_outcome_en: Minor spots will fade. Regular monitoring keeps it under control.
low.expected_outcome_ha: Ƙananan tabo za su shuɗe. Kula akai-akai yana hana cutar taɓuwa.
low.input_sourcing_en: Neem oil is sold in agro-shops. Also available as pure oil from local markets.
low.input_sourcing_ha: Ana sayar da mai neem a shagunan taki. Ana samun mai tsafta a kasuwanni.
future_prevention_ha: Duba daga farko
Yi amfani da iri masu tsafta

name_ha: Tabon ganye na kwayar cuta a shinkafa

recommended_treatment_en: Uproot and destroy severely infected plants
recommended_treatment_ha: Cire shuke-shuke masu cuta sosai ka ƙone su
Yi amfani da maganin jan karfe mai kashe kwaya
application_steps_en: Remove and burn all severely infected plants
Spray the remaining healthy plants thoroughly
Apply again after 7 days if needed
application_steps_ha: Cire duk shuke-shuke da cuta ta mamaye sosai ka ƙone su
Haɗa Copper hydroxide gram 25 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Yi feshi sosai a kan shuke-shuke da suka rage lafiya
Sake shafa bayan kwana 7 idan ya cancanta
high.dosage_en: 25g per 15L water. Spray all remaining plants.
high.dosage_ha: Gram 25 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi feshi a kan duk shuke-shuke da suka rage.
high.timing_en: Spray early morning or late evening. Avoid spraying in hot sun.
high.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe ko da yamma. Kada ka yi feshi lokacin zafin rana.
safety_warnings_en: Wear gloves, mask, and protective clothing
safety_warnings_ha: Sa safar hannu, rufe hanci, da tufafi masu kariya
Guji kusa da ruwa
Wanke hannaye bayan amfani
high.expected_outcome_en: Infection should stop within 5-7 days. New leaves will grow clean.
high.expected_outcome_ha: Cuta ya kamata ta tsaya cikin kwana 5-7. Sabbin ganye zasu girma lafiya.
high.input_sourcing_en: Copper hydroxide (e.g., Kocide) is available at agro-dealers.
high.input_sourcing_ha: Copper hydroxide (misali Kocide) ana samunsa a kantunan taki.
future_prevention_ha: Yi amfani da iri mai kyau
Yi juyin amfanin gona

recommended_treatment_en: Apply foliar fertilizer to strengthen plants
recommended_treatment_ha: Yi amfani da taki mai ƙarfafa ganye
Gyara yadda ake shayarwa (kar a bar ruwa kullum)
application_steps_en: Ensure field is drained for 2-3 days between irrigations
application_steps_ha: Yi amfani da taki mai ƙarfafa ganye kilogiram 5 a kowace hekta (misali 20-20-20)
Tabbatar ƙasa ta bushe na kwana 2-3 tsakanin shayarwa
Cire duk wani ganye da cuta ta kama sosai
moderate.dosage_en: 5kg foliar fertilizer per hectare. Apply as spray or granules.
moderate.dosage_ha: Kilogiram 5 na taki mai ƙarfafa ganye a kowace hekta. Yi amfani da feshi ko ƙwaya.
moderate.timing_en: Apply fertilizer early morning or late afternoon.
moderate.timing_ha: Yi taki da safe ko da yamma.
safety_warnings_ha: Sa safar hannu lokacin zuba taki.
Guji shiga ido.
moderate.expected_outcome_en: Plants will become stronger and resist bacteria. Disease spread will slow.
moderate.expected_outcome_ha: Shuke-shuke zasu sami ƙarfi su jure kwayar cuta. Yaɗuwar cuta za ta ragu.
moderate.input_sourcing_ha: Taki mai ƙarfafa ganye (misali NPK 20-20-20) a kantunan taki.
future_prevention_ha: Tsaida ruwan tsabta
Yi amfani da iri masu tsafta

recommended_treatment_ha: Ƙara taki ga ƙasa
Kula da gida kowane mako
application_steps_en: Incorporate into soil before planting or around plants
Check for new spots every week
application_steps_ha: Zuba taki kilogiram 2-3 a kowace murabba'i mita
Haɗa da ƙasa kafin shuka ko a kusa da shuke-shuke
Duba sababbin tabo kowane mako
low.dosage_en: 2-3kg compost per m². Apply around the base of plants.
low.dosage_ha: Kilogiram 2-3 na taki a kowace mita murabba'i. Zuba a gindin shuke-shuke.
low.timing_en: Apply compost when soil is moist, preferably in the morning.
low.timing_ha: Zuba taki lokacin ƙasa tana da ɗanshi, da safe mafi kyau.
safety_warnings_en: Compost is safe. Wash hands after handling.
safety_warnings_ha: Taki ba shi da laifi. Wanke hannaye bayan amfani.
low.expected_outcome_en: Soil health improves, plants become resilient and disease stays minor.
low.expected_outcome_ha: Lafiyar ƙasa ta inganta, shuke-shuke su sami ƙarfi, cuta ba za ta yi girma ba.
low.input_sourcing_en: Compost can be made from manure or crop residues. Ready-made compost at agro-shops.
low.input_sourcing_ha: Ana iya shirya taki daga taki ko ragowar amfanin gona. Ana sayar da taki mai shiri a shagunan noma.
future_prevention_ha: A cire ciyawa
Yi amfani da tsiro mai lafiya

recommended_treatment_en: Apply Emamectin benzoate or Chlorpyrifos insecticide
Remove and destroy heavily infested plants
recommended_treatment_ha: Yi amfani da maganin ƙwaro Emamectin benzoate ko Chlorpyrifos
Cire kuma ƙone shuke-shuke da cuta ta mamaye sosai
application_steps_en: Mix 10ml Emamectin benzoate in 15L of water
Wear gloves and nose mask before mixing
Spray directly into the funnel/whorl of each plant early morning
Repeat every 7 days until infestation stops
application_steps_ha: Haɗa Emamectin benzoate mililita 10 a cikin ruwa lita 15
Sa safar hannu da rufe hanci kafin haɗawa
Yi feshi a cikin tsakiyar ganyen masara da safe
Maimaita kowane kwana 7 har sai ƙwaron ya ƙare
high.dosage_en: 10ml per 15L water. Apply 15L per half-acre plot. Repeat weekly.
high.dosage_ha: Mililita 10 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi amfani da lita 15 a kowace rabin eka. Maimaita kowane mako.
high.timing_en: Spray early morning (before 9AM) or late evening. Avoid during flowering, do not spray if rain expected within 4 hours.
high.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe kafin karfe 9 ko da maraice. Kada ka yi feshi lokacin furanni. Kada ka yi feshi idan ruwan sama zai fado cikin awa 4.
safety_warnings_en: Wear gloves and nose mask always
Keep children and livestock away for 24 hours after spraying
Do not spray near ponds or streams
safety_warnings_ha: Sa safar hannu da rufe hanci kullum
Guji yara da dabbobi su shiga gona tsawon sa'a 24 bayan feshi
Kada ka yi feshi kusa da tafki ko kogi
Wanke hannaye sosai bayan amfani da magani
high.expected_outcome_en: Larvae should reduce within 3-5 days. New leaves should grow undamaged within 2 weeks. If no improvement after 10 days, switch insecticide.
high.expected_outcome_ha: Ƙwaro ya kamata ya ragu cikin kwana 3-5. Ganye sabon zai girma ba tare da cuta ba cikin makon 2. Idan babu sauƙi bayan kwana 10, sauya magani.
high.input_sourcing_en: Available at agro-dealer shops in Kano, Kaduna, Katsina markets. Brand names: Coragen, King Force, Armor. Organic alternative: Neem extract spray.
high.input_sourcing_ha: Ana samunsa a kantunan taki da magani a kasuwannin Kano, Kaduna, Katsina. Sunaye a kasuwa: Coragen, King Force, Armor. Madadin gargajiya: ruwan neem.
future_prevention_en: Plant early to avoid peak armyworm season
future_prevention_ha: Shuka da wuri don guje wa lokacin ƙwaro
Haɗa shuka da wake ko wake-wake

recommended_treatment_ha: Yi feshi da ruwan neem
Tattara ƙwaro da hannu ka kashe su
application_steps_en: Crush 200g neem seeds and soak in 5L water overnight
Spray into plant whorl every 5 days
application_steps_ha: Niƙa kwayan neem gram 200 ka jika su a cikin ruwa lita 5 dare ɗaya
Tace ruwan ka haɗa da ruwa lita 15
Yi feshi a tsakiyar ganye kowane kwana 5
moderate.dosage_en: 200g neem seeds per 15L water. Apply to all plants showing damage.
moderate.dosage_ha: Kwayan neem gram 200 a cikin ruwa lita 15. Yi amfani da shi ga duk shuka masu alamar cuta.
moderate.timing_en: Spray in early morning. Repeat every 5 days for 3 weeks.
moderate.timing_ha: Yi feshi da safe. Maimaita kowane kwana 5 na makon 3.
safety_warnings_en: Neem is organic but avoid eye contact
safety_warnings_ha: Neem magani ne na gida amma guji shiga ido
Wanke hannaye bayan feshi
moderate.expected_outcome_en: Damage should slow within 5-7 days. Check whorls daily for new larvae.
moderate.expected_outcome_ha: Lalacewa ya kamata ta ragu cikin kwana 5-7. Duba tsakiyar ganye kowace rana don sabon ƙwaro.
moderate.input_sourcing_en: Neem trees available locally. Neem oil also sold at agro shops. Brand: Neem Guard.
moderate.input_sourcing_ha: Itacen neem yana cikin gari. Ana sayar da mai neem a kantunan taki. Suna: Neem Guard.
future_prevention_en: Scout farm twice weekly during growing season
future_prevention_ha: Duba gona sau biyu a mako lokacin girma
Yi amfani da tarkon ƙwaro

recommended_treatment_en: Apply wood ash into whorl of affected plants
recommended_treatment_ha: Duba gona akai-akai kowane mako
Zuba toka a tsakiyar ganyen shuka masu cuta
application_steps_en: Pour 1 teaspoon directly into the funnel of affected plants
application_steps_ha: Tattara toka ta bushewa
Zuba cokali ɗaya a tsakiyar ganyen shuka masu cuta
Duba kowace rana
low.dosage_en: 1 teaspoon wood ash per plant funnel. No dilution needed.
low.dosage_ha: Cokali ɗaya na toka a kowace shuka. Ba a haɗa da ruwa.
low.timing_en: Apply in morning after dew dries.
low.timing_ha: Yi amfani da shi da safe bayan raɓa ta bushe.
safety_warnings_ha: Guji shaka turbin toka
Guji ido
low.expected_outcome_en: Minor infestations should stop spreading within 1 week. Escalate treatment if larvae multiply.
low.expected_outcome_ha: Kaɗan na ƙwaro ya kamata ya tsaya cikin mako 1. Ƙara ƙarfin magani idan sun yawaita.
low.input_sourcing_en: Wood ash available at home or from local blacksmiths.
low.input_sourcing_ha: Toka ana samunta a gida ko wurin makera.
future_prevention_ha: Shuka irin masara mai juriya kamar SAMMAZ
Kula da tsaftar gona
